segments.text:
V. 20.
A bruiſed reed—A convinced Sinner; one that is bruiſed with the Weight of Sin: Smoaking flax—One that has the leaſt good Deſire, the fainteſt Spark of Grace: Till he ſend forth judgment unto victory—That is, till he make Righteouſneſs compleatly victorious over all its Enemies.
